WHAT: Keyboard achieves glass/translucency by letting iOS system compositor handle the blur, rather than adding UIVisualEffectView (which doesn't work in extensions).

HOW:
- KeyboardViewController.view.backgroundColor = .clear
- UIInputView background = .clear
- Letter key bg = UIColor.white.withAlphaComponent(0.75) [light] / 0.18 [dark]
- Special key bg = UIColor.white.withAlphaComponent(0.60) [light] / 0.12 [dark]
- All keys: layer.borderWidth = 0.5, layer.borderColor = UIColor.white.withAlphaComponent(0.3).cgColor

WHY: iOS keyboard extension host view composites the extension's transparent areas against the blurred wallpaper/background. Setting .clear lets system blur show through. Keys need their own semi-transparent bg for visual definition.

GOTCHA: UIVisualEffectView blur does NOT work as keyboard background — extension host view is white and there's nothing behind it to blur. Only the system compositor level blur works.
